subject: OnyxCloud vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 report link, and PO workflow
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <contracts@onyxcloud.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: OnyxCloud vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 report link, and PO workflow

Alex —

Thanks for the quick chat yesterday. We're ready to move OnyxCloud through procurement so we can start the integration work next month. Procurement has asked for the standard items below before we can issue a PO: 

- Executed DPA (redlined or signed)
- Current SOC 2 report (or a link to the hosted report)
- Subprocessor inventory (name + primary subprocess + country)
- Invoice instructions and remit-to details

I've attached our redwood DPA template for reference; if you prefer to countersign your master DPA we can route that through our legal ops (flag anything that needs to stay in place). To reduce back-and-forth, please: 1) return a signed DPA or confirm intent to sign the attached DocuSign envelope, 2) upload the SOC 2 PDF or provide a URL to the report, and 3) attach your subprocessor list (CSV ok).

Quick notes on PO flow (so you're aware): Redwood issues a standard PO once procurement has the signed DPA and the invoice remit details. PO numbers follow the RDW-PO-##### format and we cannot pay until the PO is issued and the invoice references that PO number. If you require a vendor setup form filled by you, we can complete it — just confirm a contact for billing and your tax form requirements.

Target timeline: if we have the signed DPA + SOC2 link by Friday 5/15, procurement will aim to issue a PO the following week. Can you confirm?

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan
Vendor Onboarding Lead | Redwood Inference
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0214

Attachment: redwood_dpa_v3.pdf (Redwood DPA template, for reference)

From: Alex Morgan <contracts@onyxcloud.com>

Cc: 
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 11:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OnyxCloud vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 report link, and PO workflow

Hi Priya —

Thanks for the clear list. We're aligned and can get everything over by Thursday. Quick answers and attachments: 

- I've attached a signed copy of OnyxCloud_Signed_DPA_v1.pdf (we executed this internally today).
- SOC 2 report is hosted here: https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-reports/soc2/onyxcloud-soc2-2026.pdf (read-only link).
- Subprocessor inventory attached: onyxcloud_subprocessors_2026-05.csv (exports name, service, country).
- Billing contact and remit: Finance AP <ap@onyxcloud.com>; Remit-to: OnyxCloud Inc., 880 Market St, Suite 2100, San Francisco, CA 94102; EIN: 12-3456789. Invoices should be sent to invoices@onyxcloud.com and reference the PO number once provided.

One question: are there any procurement-specific fields we should include on the invoice (cost center, department code, or special routing)? Also, our contracts team prefers DocuSign for execution — if you can send the envelope link we can countersign there.

Alex Morgan
Head of Contracts | OnyxCloud Inc.
contracts@onyxcloud.com

Attachments: OnyxCloud_Signed_DPA_v1.pdf, onyxcloud_subprocessors_2026-05.csv

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 08:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: OnyxCloud vendor activation — DPA, SOC2 report link, and PO workflow

Alex —

Appreciate the rapid turnaround and the attachments. Confirming receipt of the signed DPA and subprocessor CSV. Two procurement follow-ups: 

1) Invoice fields: please include "RDW-PO" in the invoice reference field. We'll provide the full PO number when procurement issues it. Optional fields that speed processing: cost center (e.g., ENG-ML), Redwood contact (Priya Natarajan), and invoice line descriptions that reference the subscription or per-token billing model.

2) DocuSign: procurement/legal asked that we use the embedded DocuSign so we have an auditable envelope. I created a prepared envelope for the redwood template in case there were changes; use this link to review and sign: https://app.docusign.com/prepare?envelopeId=abc123-onyx-dpa. If you've already got a countersigned PDF (attached) that works too — procurement can ingest that into the vendor record.

Ben, assigning this to you for PO issuance once we have the final invoice remit details confirmed. Karthik, can you please confirm whether the subprocessor CSV requires any additional fields for our privacy inventory before we ingest?

Thanks — target to close this by Friday.

Best,
Priya

Alex / Priya —

Thanks for the confirmations. Procurement created the PO this morning: RDW-PO-78912. Alex, please put RDW-PO-78912 in the invoice reference and re-send the invoice to invoices@onyxcloud.com. Once we receive an invoice that references the PO we will push payment through our AP workflow.

Karthik — subprocessor CSV looks fine for ingestion; I'll drop it in the vendor privacy tracker and flag OnyxCloud as "approved - monitoring". Priya — I'll attach the PO to the vendor record and close the onboarding ticket after we receive the invoice.

Alex — welcome aboard. If you need the vendor portal link to upload future compliance evidence, here's the tenant: https://vendors.redwood.com/onyxcloud (you'll get an invite later today).

Regards,
